history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration use an appropriate way to disclose the budget implementation for the two projects, including the extended retention of commitments, to increase information transparency.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. In annex V of the supplementary information to the proposed programme budget for 2026, under section 33, Construction, alteration, improvement and major maintenance (A/80/6 (Sect. 33)), detailed information is provided on the implementation of the water tank replacement project and the exit ramp project. The General Assembly exit ramp project was completed in December 2024, while the water tank replacement project was completed in May 2025. Further detailed data by budget section and object of expenditure will also be made available in the Budget Information Pilot tool.
history.board_assessment: Given that the information on the budget implementation for the two projects was included in the proposed programme budget for 2026, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
